summary_en: MS&Consulting authorized buyback of up to 700,000 shares (15.5% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock) for maximum 350 million yen over October 16, 2026 to October 15, 2027 via market purchase on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Acquired shares will be used for employee stock incentive plans and future capital or business partnerships.
title_en: Notice regarding Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief:
MS&Consulting's board of directors resolved on October 15, 2026 to acquire up to 700,000 treasury shares, representing 15.5% of shares outstanding (excluding treasury stock), for a maximum of 350 million yen. The acquisition will be conducted through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from October 16, 2026 through October 15, 2027.

The company stated that the buyback is intended to support sustained improvement in corporate value while emphasizing shareholder returns and capital efficiency improvement. It aims to enhance ROE and enable flexible capital policies in response to changing business conditions. The company does not currently plan to cancel the acquired shares.

Acquired treasury shares will be used for employee stock incentive plans and performance-based compensation programs. Additionally, the company intends to potentially use the shares as consideration for future capital alliances or business partnerships in executing growth strategies, though no such transactions have been specifically decided at the time of this disclosure.
